title: Numpad quick skills (not possessed): what goes wrong?
intro: Diagnostic. Numpad 1-4 are PawnCommander's quick skill keys for your pawns while you play the Arisen. This records what the game sees when you press them and what the main pawn does.

steps.text: Open ground. CLOSE the REFramework menu (Insert) after pressing End. Press End
Menu CLOSED. Press Numpad 1, wait 3 s, Numpad 2, wait, Numpad 3, wait, Numpad 4.

expect.label: numpad sent arrow/End keys instead (NumLock off)

steps.text: Now OPEN the REFramework menu (Insert) and press Numpad 1 once. Then close it and press End

probes.ui_open: local ok, v = pcall(reframework.is_drawing_ui, reframework); return ok and v or nil
probes.num:
local s = ""
for n = 1, 6 do if reframework:is_key_down(0x60 + n) then s = s .. n end end
return s ~= "" and s or nil
probes.nav:
local m = { [0x23] = "End/1", [0x28] = "Down/2", [0x22] = "PgDn/3", [0x25] = "Left/4", [0x0C] = "Clear/5", [0x27] = "Right/6" }
local s = ""
for vk, nm in pairs(m) do if reframework:is_key_down(vk) then s = s .. nm .. " " end end
return s ~= "" and s or nil
probes.row:
local s = ""
for n = 1, 6 do if reframework:is_key_down(0x30 + n) then s = s .. n end end
return s ~= "" and s or nil
probes.pskill: local pw = H.pawn(0); local h = pw and pw:call("get_Human"); return h and h:call("get_CustomSkillState")
probes.pdrawn: local pw = H.pawn(0); return pw and pw:call('get_IsDrawedWeapon')
probes.pc_cfg:
local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "pawn_commander_config.json"); if not (ok and d) then return "no config" end
return tostring(d.hotkeys_enabled) .. " " .. tostring(d.keys and d.keys.skill_1)
